title: Complex Bohr-Sommerfeld action and a stability obstruction
exact_target: Find a complex Bohr--Sommerfeld eigenvalue rule and relate it to the Hermitian rule.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002494 (AIM-PHYSICS-0002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Non-Hermitian quantum mechanics and symplectic geometry, source item 1.2.

status_qualification: The source leaves the analytic symbol’s global assumptions and admissible cycles unspecified. The Hermitian rule is explanatory context, not an assertion that an unchanged real-action formula holds for arbitrary non-Hermitian operators. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
